Migration guide (v1 → v2) {{ds:component/chip|label=v1 retired|variant=danger}}

v1 reached end of life on 2026-08-01 alongside the webhooks GA changelog entry. This guide covers the three breaking changes you need to handle to move a v1 integration to v2.

1. Pagination: offset → cursor

v1 used page/per_page query parameters. v2 uses an opaque cursor and next_cursor — see Rate limits & errors for the exact envelope.

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=diff|language=diff|code=- GET /v1/pipelines?page=2&per_page=20 + GET /v2/pipelines?cursor=eyJvZmZzZXQiOjIwfQ}}

2. Status checks: polling → webhooks

v1 had no push notifications — you polled a pipeline's status endpoint. v2 replaces this with the Webhooks endpoint: subscribe to pipeline.completed and pipeline.failed instead of polling.

3. Error shape

v1 returned bare error strings. v2 wraps every error in an object with a stable code field. Update any error handling that matched on message text — see the error shape reference.

{{ds:component/alert|variant=danger|title=v1 is retired|body_html=

v1 endpoints no longer accept requests. If you're seeing 404s on /v1/* paths, that's why — there is no grace-period fallback.

}}

Migration guide (v2 → v3) {{ds:component/chip|label=v2 withdrawn|variant=danger}}

v2 has reached end of life and is no longer accepting requests. This guide covers the breaking changes you need to handle to move a v2 integration to v3.

1. Endpoint paths: /pipelines/{id}/events → events are first-class resources

In v2, events were nested under pipelines. v3 promotes events to first-class resources with their own endpoints:

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=diff|language=diff|code=- GET /v2/pipelines/{pipeline_id}/events?cursor=... + GET /v3/events?pipeline_id={pipeline_id}&cursor=...}}

Events are now listed globally but can still be filtered by pipeline ID, type, and occurrence range.

2. Replay endpoint consolidation

The replay endpoint path is simplified to work with the new structure:

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=diff|language=diff|code=- POST /v2/events/{id}/replay + POST /v3/events/{id}/replay}}

The request and response bodies remain identical.

3. Pagination and filtering improvements

Query parameters are now more consistent across endpoints:

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=diff|language=diff|code=- GET /v2/pipelines/{pipeline_id}/events?type=order.created&since=2026-08-18T00:00:00Z&cursor=... + GET /v3/events?pipeline_id={pipeline_id}&type=order.created&since=2026-08-18T00:00:00Z&cursor=...}}

All filters are now optional query parameters, giving you more flexibility in listing events.

{{ds:component/alert|variant=danger|title=v2 endpoints are disabled|body_html=

v2 API endpoints no longer accept requests. If you're seeing 410 Gone responses, that's why — there is no grace-period fallback. Update your integration immediately.

}}
